source_crime: Oslo kommune Statistikkbanken, table KRI002 (Anmeldte lovbrudd med gjerningssted i Oslo, etter type lovbrudd og gjerningsbydel), 'Alle lovbruddsgrupper' (total offences), year 2024. https://statistikkbanken.oslo.kommune.no/statbank/pxweb/no/db1/db1__Kriminalitet/KRI002.px/ -- KRI002's own gjerningssted list has 18 entries: the 15 real bydeler, '16 Sentrum', and '99 Uoppgitt gjerningsbydel, inkludert Marka', so Sentrum has its own real, distinct crime figure even though it is not an administrative bydel.
source_population: For the 15 administrative bydeler: Oslo kommune Statistikkbanken, table BEF005 (Folkemengden etter administrativ bydel og alder), 'Alder i alt' (all ages), year 2024. https://statistikkbanken.oslo.kommune.no/statbank/pxweb/no/db1/db1__Befolkning__Folkemengde/OK-BEF005.px/ -- BEF005 has no Sentrum row, because Sentrum is not part of Oslo's administrative-bydel service-delivery structure (Store norske leksikon: 'Sentrum og Marka star utenfor bydelsordningen; disse er regnet som fellesomrader for kommunens innbyggere'). For Sentrum specifically: Statistics Norway (SSB) table 10826 (Population in urban districts, by sex and age (UD)), region code 030116a Sentrum, year 2024, summed across all age bands = 1,528. https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/10826/ -- this is SSB's own separate 'urban district' geographic breakdown, not Oslo kommune's administrative-bydel system, but it is a real, official, citable population figure for the same Sentrum area KRI002 reports crime for.
note: Oslo's 15 official administrative bydeler (each with its own bydelsutvalg/local borough council) are the main zones. Sentrum (the financial/commercial/nightlife city-centre area) is ALSO mapped as a 16th zone using KRI002's own '16 Sentrum' crime figure and SSB table 10826's population figure for the same area -- added 24 August 2026 after the initial 15-zone build left a visible, unexplained gap right in the middle of the map where Sentrum sits (a real usability problem: Sentrum is exactly where a lot of hotels are). 'Marka' (forest, effectively unpopulated, no hotels/accommodation) remains excluded, since KRI002 does not give it its own figure either (it is folded into the catch-all '99 Uoppgitt gjerningsbydel, inkludert Marka' row, which mixes it with unknown-location offences and so cannot honestly be attributed to Marka specifically).
